Maya (Product): quick thread: uploaded a new dense-rows mock that tries to balance scanability vs row density. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/dense-rows -> core question: show full token breakdown inline or surface top-2 + overflow? Noah (Design): I prototyped three options: full inline numbers (4.2k | 1.1k | 200), top-2 + "+1" overflow, and single compact summary ("5.5k tokens") with chevron. Visuals attached in comments. Sam (PM): growth flag: visible info wins. conversions drop if users have to expand. leaning top-2 only if it keeps context for most users. Priya (Eng): perf note: rendering many DOM elements per row across large tables is the killer. single text span or an SVG per row is cheapest. If we go with overflow, the detail panel must be lazy-loaded. Lena (A11y): no hover-only reveals. keyboard access parity is required. for screen readers, each row should include an aria-summary like "Token breakdown: Prompt 4.2k, Completion 1.1k, Cached 200". also double-check contrast for small inline numbers in dark theme. Maya (Product): suggestion: default to top-2 inline + "+n" overflow which opens a lightweight drawer; desktop shows top-2, mobile shows compact summary with expand. keyboard focus on the "+n" should open the drawer. Ibrahim (Finance): CSV/export requirement: whatever the UI shows must map to raw columns. customers expect exports with columns: transaction_id,account_id,project_id,token_bucket,model_name,tokens,cost_usd,date. If we aggregate on the UI, ensure the export preserves original buckets. Noah (Design): alternative micro-compromise: show top-2 inline and add a tiny accessible expander icon with title "View full token breakdown". keeps rows tidy but discoverable. Priya (Eng): implementation plan: API returns an aggregated preview payload (top_2, total_tokens, breakdown_url) and a full breakdown blob when requested. we'll render top-2 as a single text node to avoid per-slice DOM. drawer content will be fetched on first open. Lena (A11y): sample aria pattern to include in the drawer trigger: ```html
Prompt: 4.2k, Completion: 1.1k, Cached: 200
``` Sam (PM): copy nit: across product we should standardize on "Projected monthly cost" instead of "Estimated monthly spend". Marketing and billing use "cost" language. Maya (Product): decision draft: desktop = top-2 inline + overflow; mobile = compact total + expand; keyboard = expander is focusable and opens drawer; export/CSV will expose raw buckets (Finance to sign off on schema); render top-2 as single text node/SVG for perf; A11y to verify aria-labels and dark-mode contrast. Deploy-bot: preview build #701 deployed to preview branch: https://preview.redwood/branch/dense-rows-701 Priya (Eng): I'll schedule a perf sweep on low-end Chrome/Android and post results here. Ibrahim (Finance): I'll draft the CSV header proposal and example rows and post by EOD for sign-off. Noah (Design): I'll update mocks to reflect top-2 + accessible expander and annotate color tokens for contrast checks. Maya (Product): thanks all I'll post a short Loom summarizing the decision and next steps after the perf pass. :white_check_mark:
